title: Open subsets of a one-dimensional Noetherian local spectrum
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] whose Krull dimension is at most one [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and let $S=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be its affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every open subset $W\subseteq S$, if the closed point $\mathfrak m$ belongs to $W$, then $W=S$; if $\mathfrak m\notin W$, then $W$ has a finite discrete underlying topological space and the induced open subscheme is affine.
